literal_meaning: ঔষধ (medicine) পড়া (to fall or take effect)
figurative_meaning_en: To take effect or have an influence
example_sentences_in_bangla: ওষুধটা খাওয়ার পর কিছুক্ষণ পর ঔষধ পড়ল।
তার কথাগুলো শুনে আমার মনে ঔষধ পড়ল।
example_sentences_in_english: The medicine started to take effect after a few minutes.
His words began to have an influence on my mind.
note: Commonly used in contexts where something begins to work or influence after initial application.
